title: IsoAct: Geometry-Aware Post-hoc Debiasing via Isometric Actions
abstract: arXiv:2610.34690v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning representations that are robust to nuisance factors is essential for reliable deployment, but remains challenging when the representations lie on non-Euclidean manifolds. Existing debiasing methods typically assume Euclidean representations or apply linear interventions, which can distort the geometry of structured latent spaces. We propose IsoAct, a post-hoc framework that accounts for geometry in both nuisance identification and representation editing. It identifies nuisance-predictive directions using Fisher discriminant analysis (FDA) in tangent coordinates and applies corrections through manifold-native actions that preserve manifold membership. Controlled and real-world experiments on hyperspherical, hyperbolic, and $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ representations evaluate nuisance reduction, utility preservation, and manifold validity jointly. translated_title: IsoAct：基于等距作用的几何感知事后去偏方法
translated_abstract: 学习对干扰因素具有鲁棒性的表示对于模型的可靠部署至关重要，但当表示位于非欧几里得流形上时，这仍然是一个挑战。现有的去偏方法通常假设表示是欧几里得的，或者采用线性干预，这可能会扭曲结构化潜在空间的几何结构。我们提出了 IsoAct，这是一个在干扰因素识别和表示编辑两个环节中都充分考虑几何结构的事后（post-hoc）框架。它利用切空间坐标下的费舍尔判别分析（FDA）来识别可预测干扰因素的方向，并通过保持流形成员关系的流形原生作用来施加修正。在超球面、双曲面和 SE(3) 表示上进行的受控实验和真实世界实验，联合评估了干扰因素减少、效用保持和流形有效性。IsoAct 在保持具有竞争力的效用的同时，降低了干扰因素的可恢复性。
tldr: IsoAct 提出了一个几何感知的事后去偏框架，通过在切空间中使用费舍尔判别分析识别干扰方向，并以保持流形结构的等距作用进行修正，在超球面、双曲面和 SE(3) 等非欧几里得表示上实现干扰信息消除与任务效用保持的平衡。
en_tdlr: IsoAct is a geometry-aware post-hoc debiasing framework that identifies nuisance-predictive directions via Fisher discriminant analysis in tangent coordinates and applies manifold-native isometric corrections, reducing nuisance recoverability while preserving utility and manifold structure in non-Euclidean representations such as hyperspherical, hyperbolic, and SE(3) spaces.
